# Fixes
- Diverse Logic Fixes
- `Progressive Animatronics` failgenning A LOT
- Dusting Fields teleport being in the wrong place
- The `Update` button not flashing in `Halloween Land`
- Universal Tracker *should* work now
- Filler items not properlly being distributed

# Changes
- `Archipelago.json` has been adjusted slighly
- `Fazcoin Chests` new minimum is 3 (used to be 1), the new maximum is 5 (used to be 3), this has been done because of logic changes.

# Known Issues
###### These will be fixed in future hotfixes or with the next release, if fixed in a hotfix they will be crossed out like ~~this~~
- There is a very low (about 1%) failgen chance with goal being set to `magic_rainbow` and logic difficulty being set to `easy` (and in rarer cases `normal`)

# Hotfixes
08/10: Patching works correctly now and corrected the version number in the client (I know it is not fixed in the game but we'll ignore that till the next hotfix)
